cases.query: When the authenticated telemetry endpoint is temporarily unavailable, how does the OpenCode plugin deliver the host-call envelope, what queue and retry limits apply, and what default Windows queue path and override does it use?
When delivery fails because the authenticated endpoint is temporarily unavailable, what exactly is queued and what are the queue capacity and maximum retry count?
What is the maximum number of entries in the local host-call queue?
When may the host automatically propagate a traceId, and in which situations must the caller still supply it explicitly?
When an event arrives, which responsibilities stay with the host/provider, what does portable MSSR evaluate, and how must polling be represented when no native event capability exists?
